initial_observation: An eligible separate assessor recorded text after a notebook-only request.

packet.goal: I want to learn how to worship god better
packet.new_task: In an imagined town the music hall has stood empty for months. Write an optional line of lament for a player who misses making music with others. Explain how the line takes its form from this passage. Keeping the exercise private is also a choice.

response.response: “How long will the hall stay silent before we play together again?” The line takes its form from the passage’s image of a hall left empty for months. It turns that long silence into a question and ends with what the player misses most: making music with others.
